question.text: For the reaction <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mfenced><mi>g</mi></mfenced></msub><mo>→</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced></msub></math>,  the value of the equilibrium constant at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>300</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math> is equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo></math> The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>ΔG</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></msup></math> for the reaction at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>300</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math> in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Jmol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mi>x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>,</mo></math> where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is (Rounded off to the nearest integer) <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>31</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi>mol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mo> </mo><mi>and</mi><mo> </mo><mi>ln</mi><mn>10</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>
